author.name: Edgar Allan Poe
author.heading: About Edgar Allan Poe
author.bio: Poe wrote both poetry and short fiction, often using narrators whose experiences complicate the boundary between perception and reality. Eleonora is one of the tales in which that imaginative perspective matters.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The sentence opens Eleonora’s reflection on imagination and perception. It is a literary narrator’s statement inside a tale, so quoting it as a personal clinical judgment by Poe would blur fiction and autobiography.
